summary_md: **Liam ([@LiamSwiftTheDog](https://x.com/LiamSwiftTheDog/status/2116208543707619572))** updates **Asset Jam Studio**, a local game-asset studio where Claude builds artist-like low-poly models and textures by filling base colors, rendering views and finishing with img2img, avoiding blobby generative-3D meshes ([LiamDobbelaere/Asset-Jam-Studio](https://github.com/LiamDobbelaere/Asset-Jam-Studio)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - LiamDobbelaere/Asset-Jam-Studio: Fully local game-asset studio: 3D props, seamless textures, sprites, voice lines, music, intro videos and animated characters from text, on your own GPU. No subscriptions, no cloud.
